data.desc: Axe Compute Inc. (NASDAQ: AGPU) is a neocloud AI infrastructure platform built on a fundamental premise: AI innovation should not be constrained by hardware choice or availability. The company provides enterprises and AI innovators with flexibility across hardware, geography, and deployment models. Axe Compute designs, deploys, owns, and operates large-scale, dedicated AI infrastructure worldwide, supported by enterprise-grade SLAs and operational expertise.
